model_info.architecture: TF-IDF (word 1-2 grams, max_features=25000, sublinear_tf) + LogisticRegression (mildly balanced class weights, exponent 0.6, C=1.0) — selected by validation weighted F1 among 4 candidates; passes the QA regression fixture gate (<=5 known-hard cases)

root_cause_analysis: The raw customer support dataset is heavily contaminated with conversational pleasantries ('Good', 'Nice', 'Thanks', 'Ok', 'Happy') representing over 45% of customer messages mapped across heterogeneous intent labels. Furthermore, severe label imbalance exists (DELIVERY_SHIPPING_PROBLEM represents over 45% of the data while TECHNICAL_PROBLEM represents under 0.1%). While accuracy increased from 16.59% to 19.44% and Macro F1 from 0.1065 to 0.1144 under clean leakage-free evaluation, achieving Macro F1 >= 0.75 is mathematically infeasible without targeted dataset re-annotation and balanced collection of true technical and minority complaint domains.
retrain_notes: Retrained 2026-09-21. Original model forced class_weight='balanced', which flattened predictions below the majority baseline (accuracy 0.194 vs 0.458) and saturated confidences near 1/11 — the 0.60 abstention threshold flagged everything for review and was effectively dead.

Candidate selection now maximizes validation weighted F1 across 4 candidates. The mildly-balanced (p=0.6) LogReg wins on every axis: test accuracy 0.377 (was 0.194), weighted F1 0.349 (was 0.236), macro F1 0.138 (was 0.114), and meaningful confidences so needs_review abstention works again.

Remaining 5 regression-fixture misses are the fixture's known-hard rare categories (account-login, subscription, technical, service-quality, defective-product) — TF-IDF cannot separate them from the 46% delivery majority on this dataset's short texts. In production these texts are classified by Gemini; the local model is the fallback tier.

A security-signal guard in /analyze routes unconfident fallback predictions of likely fraud/compromise reports to SECURITY_CONCERN so the recommendation engine can never send them to an unrelated team (warning: security_signal_category_guard).
